Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the state lottery to provide scratch tickets as a promotional activity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to scratch tickets as a promotional activity; andadding a new section to chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state lottery may provide as a promotional activity, free orfor a charge, scratch tickets to persons otherwise eligible to purchaselottery tickets, and to licensed retailers for distribution to personsotherwise eligible to purchase lottery tickets. Only scratch ticketswith a retail price of one or two dollars may be used under thissection. The state lottery shall limit promotional scratch tickets tono more than one percent of the annual sales of one or two dollarscratch tickets. Promotional scratch tickets provided under thissection must be conducted in accordance with rules established forpromotional activities. Rules adopted under this section must includeaudit and reporting provisions. If the projected revenue from the state lottery as outlined by therevenue forecast council is lower than ten percent, then the commission p. 1 HB 2280must review the use of promotional scratch tickets and may suspend theuse of promotional scratch tickets.
